DetailsSection.longDes: Coffee, a beloved global beverage, is brewed from roasted coffee beans, which are seeds of the Coffea plant. Known for its rich aroma and diverse flavors, it offers a perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness. Coffee is cherished for its energizing properties, thanks to caffeine, and its versatility, from espresso shots to creamy lattes.
